summary: OpenAI and Broadcom announced a jointly developed custom inference chip named Jalapeño designed to optimize large language model inference performance, efficiency and scale.

mechanisms.reason: OpenAI is co-developing a custom inference chip with Broadcom, indicating a move away from purely merchant accelerators for inference workloads.
mechanisms.quote: OpenAI and Broadcom introduce Jalapeño, a custom AI chip built for LLM inference to improve performance, efficiency, and scale across AI systems.

categories.reason: A named custom AI inference chip developed with a silicon partner directly affects demand and design activity in the accelerator/custom silicon space.
categories.quote: OpenAI and Broadcom introduce Jalapeño, a custom AI chip built for LLM inference to improve performance, efficiency, and scale across AI systems.

notable_reason: A major AI lab partnering with a chipmaker to build a custom inference chip is a significant signal for the semiconductor supply chain, even though details are sparse.
